描述_EN: the lines of the peony were then carved out, revealing the buff colour of the body as the background to this striking design. to achieve its effect, a cream slip (a thinned firing clay) was first applied over the body. contrary to the imperial wares of the time, which were prized for their perfection of form and glaze, cizhou wares were made for everyday use and so were more free-spirited in form and design. cizhou is a term used to describe a variety of ceramics made in northern china during the song dynasty (960-1279). this octagonal ceramic pillow is an example of cizhou ware. this pillow is typical of cizhou ware in its bold surface decoration over a stoneware body.
描述_ZN: 然后雕刻出牡丹的线条，揭示了作为这个引人注目的设计的背景的身体的水色。 为了达到其效果，首先在器身上涂抹了奶油滑液（一种稀薄的烧制粘土）。 与当时的御用器物不同，御用器物以其完美的形式和釉面而受到推崇，而慈禧的器物是为日常使用而制作的，因此在形式和设计上更加自由奔放。 在中国北方的宋代（960-1279年）的陶瓷中，"Cizhou "是一个用来描述各种陶瓷的术语。 这个八角形的陶瓷枕头是一个贵州器皿的例子。 这个枕头是典型的贵州器物，它在石器上有大胆的表面装饰。
